title: 5 April 1963: The Beatles receive their first silver disc
content:
On this day The Beatles were awarded their first silver disc, for sales of more than 250,000 copies of their single ‘Please Please Me’.

During the presentation ceremony the group gave a private performance to record company executives at EMI House, central London.

Also present was The Beatles’ producer George Martin, pictured here with the group.

A video of the private performance was uploaded to YouTube in January 2022.

Page last updated: 25 November 2022
